# VenTu

> VenTu (https://ventu.surf) publishes water-sports conditions for Portugal: 189 spots with per-sport scores (surf, kitesurf, windsurf, foil, SUP, wakeboard, bodyboard, big wave), an interactive map, and forecasts refreshed every 2h (day) / 4h (night) from Open-Meteo, IH (Instituto Hidrográfico), IPMA and MeteoAlarm. Free and open source (MIT). Site in Portuguese (default), English, Spanish, German and French; every page has hreflang alternates. Pages are prerendered static HTML (the interactive map itself renders client-side; spot data is in the JSON feeds below). Scores are 0-100 per sport (80+ epic, 60+ good). Admin, account and auth URLs are noindex.

## Site (per language: /pt/, /en/, /es/, /de/, /fr/)

- [Home](https://ventu.surf/pt/): today's top spots, scores and Dawn Patrol briefing
- [Map](https://ventu.surf/pt/mapa/): interactive map of every spot with live scores
- [Spots catalog](https://ventu.surf/pt/spots/): all spots with conditions; each spot page is /{locale}/spots/{slug}/
- [Explore](https://ventu.surf/pt/explorar/): spots by sport and region (SEO landings)
- [Sports](https://ventu.surf/pt/modalidades/): per-sport guides and spot lists
- [Seasonality](https://ventu.surf/pt/sazonalidade/): when each spot works best
- [News & events](https://ventu.surf/pt/news/): nautical news and events (articles at /{locale}/news/{slug}/)
- [Directory](https://ventu.surf/pt/diretorio/): schools and shops (/diretorio/{slug}/)
- [Livecams](https://ventu.surf/pt/livecams/): curated live cameras at spots
- [Tools](https://ventu.surf/pt/ferramentas/): kite-size and wetsuit calculators
- [Data sources](https://ventu.surf/pt/fontes/): every source with licence and attribution
- [About](https://ventu.surf/pt/about/): project, methodology and scoring

## Languages

- [Português (default)](https://ventu.surf/pt/)
- [English](https://ventu.surf/en/)
- [Español](https://ventu.surf/es/)
- [Deutsch](https://ventu.surf/de/)
- [Français](https://ventu.surf/fr/)

## Machine-readable feeds

- [Sitemap (hreflang)](https://ventu.surf/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL in all 5 languages
- [RSS — Notícias (PT)](https://ventu.surf/rss.xml)
- [RSS — News (EN)](https://ventu.surf/rss-en.xml)
- [Conditions snapshot (JSON)](https://ventu.surf/data/conditions.json): latest baked conditions per spot
- [Spots index (JSON)](https://ventu.surf/data/spots-index.json): spot catalog (slug, name, region, coordinates)
- [Dawn Patrol (JSON)](https://ventu.surf/data/dawn-patrol.json): morning briefing per spot
- [News (JSON)](https://ventu.surf/data/news.json): news items with slugs
- [Directory (JSON)](https://ventu.surf/data/directory.json): schools and shops
- [Coastal warnings (JSON)](https://ventu.surf/data/ih-coastal-warnings.json): IH navigation warnings
